defs.def: the first meal of the day 早餐；早饭verb

ex.s: ·You’ll get airport pickup, accommodation with breakfast, free-time activities
ex.t: 你会得到机场接机、含早餐的住宿以及空闲时间活动安排的服务。

ex.s: 00 — 10:00 amBreakfast at the hotel
ex.t: 10:00 am在项目地点工作，或享受你的自由时间

ex.s: On our final morning in the house, we took a break from the mind-bending, never-ending work of packing to sit down for that last breakfast.
ex.t: 在老房子里的最后一个早晨，我们从令人头疼、没完没了的打包工作中歇下来，坐下来吃最后一顿早餐。

ex.s: She said: “I used to keep hens when I was younger and had to prepare their breakfast each morning before I went to school. ”
ex.t: 她说："我年轻时也养过母鸡，每天早上上学前得给它们准备早餐。"

ex.s: How pleased and proud Mother would be when they brought her breakfast in bed.
ex.t: 当他们把早餐送到床上时，妈妈会多么高兴和自豪。

ex.s: How pleased and proud Mother would be when they brought her breakfast in bed.
ex.t: 当他们把早餐送到床上时，妈妈会多么高兴和自豪。

ex.s: The twins carried the breakfast upstairs and woke their mother up.
ex.t: 双胞胎把早餐端上楼叫醒了母亲。

ex.s: Which can be included in Mrs White's breakfast?
ex.t: 哪些可以包含在怀特太太的早餐中？

ex.s: Which can be included in Mrs White's breakfast?
ex.t: White夫人的早餐可以包括哪些内容？

ex.s: For those who can stomach it, working out before breakfast may be more beneficial for health than eating first, according to a study of meal timing and physical activity.
ex.t: 根据一项关于进餐时间与身体活动的研究，对那些能承受的人来说，早餐前锻炼可能比先吃饭更有益健康。

ex.s: Most obviously, the men displayed lower blood sugar levels at the start of their workouts when they had skipped breakfast than when they had eaten.
ex.t: 最明显的是，这些男性在不吃早餐时开始锻炼的血糖水平比吃早餐时更低。

ex.s: These genes were much more active when the men had fasted before exercise than when they had breakfasted.
ex.t: 这些基因在男性运动前禁食时比吃早餐时活跃得多。

ex.s: digest the meal easilyB. manage without breakfast
ex.t: 这些结果的启示是，要从运动中获得最大的健康益处，不吃东西可能是明智的选择。

ex.s: What happened to those who ate breakfast before exercise?
ex.t: 那些在锻炼前吃早餐的人发生了什么？

ex.s: A workout after breakfast improves gene performances.
ex.t: 早餐后锻炼能改善基因表现。

ex.s: Physical exercise before breakfast is better for health.
ex.t: 过度运动会减慢新陈代谢率。

ex.s: More than half（53 percent）have breakfast alone and nearly half（46 percent）have lunch by themselves.
ex.t: 超过一半（53%）的人独自吃早餐，近半数（46%）的人独自吃午餐。

ex.s: Very early in the morning, Uncle Paul woke us up to have breakfast.
ex.t: 他们看起来真的很酷。

ex.s: Do you want to get up in time to have breakfast with your family, get in some exercise, or just be better prepared for your day?
ex.t: 你是想按时起床和家人一起吃早餐、做些运动，还是想更好地为新的一天做准备？

ex.s: If you want time to have breakfast with your family, save some time the night before by setting out clothes, shoes, and bags.
ex.t: 如果你想有时间和家人一起吃早餐，前一天晚上就把衣服、鞋子和包准备好来节省时间。

ex.s: Stop eating fast food and have breakfast every day.
ex.t: 停止吃快餐，每天要吃早餐。

ex.s: Dad can cook a super "full English breakfast "of bacon, eggs, beans, sausages and toast with butter if Mum and I can find a way to get him into the kitchen!
ex.t: 如果我和妈妈能想办法把爸爸弄进厨房，他就能做一顿超级棒的“全套英式早餐”——熏肉、鸡蛋、豆子、香肠和黄油吐司！

ex.s: I had bacon and eggs for breakfast, and now I'm feeling a bit sick - I hope I can make it to Bank station...
ex.t: 我早餐吃了熏肉和鸡蛋，现在觉得有点不舒服——希望我能撑到银行站……

ex.s: Todd cried out in shock and waved his arm at the pale blue screen hovering above the breakfast table.
ex.t: 托德震惊地叫出声，对着悬在早餐桌上方的淡蓝色屏幕挥动手臂。

ex.s: It was not until an hour later that he noticed that Carolyn had left her emergency call device on the breakfast table.
ex.t: 直到一小时后，他才发现卡洛琳把她的紧急呼叫器落在了早餐桌上。
